text: one big performance problem on the uv still is panning the canvas around
resolution: Removed raw-pointer-rate React churn from UV canvas panning. Motion now keeps the latest camera sample and reconciles once per presented host frame; the grid and dense mesh edges remain immutable in atlas space and pan through Graph view transforms instead of rebuilding screen-space point arrays for every SDL packet. Dense vertex handles are batched and the ReleaseFast editor build plus focused UV tests pass.
